name: Toppara ~Zashikiwarashi no Hanashi~
original_name: とっぱら～ざしきわらしのはなし～
source:
The player takes the role of Itsukaichi Keiji, a teenager that lives by himself in the town of Tokieda, with his closest living relative being his granduncle, an author and researcher of the paranormal. Our protagonist has the peculiar ability to recognize supernatural beings with ease as well as the ability to see ghosts and other entities not visible to normal humans. Due to a complicated set of circumstances, Keiji has a strong hatred for ghosts and phantoms (also known as youkai), blaming them for the problems in his life.

Keiji's life has taken a bit of a downturn since the death of his parents, and is generally seen as a loner that makes little effort to interact with others. His life suddenly changes direction when a kage-onna by the name of Mikage appears in his house one day, claiming that she is bound to him and that she will be keeping him company.

Mikage's appearance is only the beginning, as our protagonist crosses paths with eight heroines in total as he discovers love, learns why things are the way they are and grows to accept his reality.

[From [url=http://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/28990.html]Moroboshi Yuumei's review[/url]]
translation:
玩家将扮演五日市圭司，一名独自生活在时枝镇的少年。他最近的亲人是叔祖父，一位作家兼超自然现象研究者。主人公拥有一种奇特能力，能够轻易辨认超自然生物，也能看见普通人无法看到的幽灵及其他存在。由于一连串复杂的经历，圭司十分憎恨幽灵和妖怪，将生活中的种种问题归咎于它们。

父母去世后，圭司的生活每况愈下，通常被视为不愿与他人交往的独行者。某天，一名叫御影的影女出现在他家中，声称自己与他缔结了束缚，将陪伴他左右，他的生活也随之突然改变。

御影的出现只是开始。主人公总共会与八位女主角相遇，在发现爱情、了解事情为何如此，并学会接受现实的过程中逐渐成长。

[摘自[url=http://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/28990.html]Moroboshi Yuumei的评论[/url]]
